chloride.options.clouds.height.title: Cloud Height
chloride.options.clouds.height.desc:
Raises cloud height.
Configure the height of the clouds
chloride.options.nametag.disable_renderi:
Do not show me your name!
Disables nametag rendering for players and entities
chloride.options.displayfps.title: Display FPS
chloride.options.displayfps.desc: Displays the current FPS. Advanced mode also displays minimum FPS, as well as 15 second average FPS, useful for judging performance.
chloride.options.displayfps.gravity.desc: Corner position of the FPS display
chloride.options.displayfps.system.title: Display Metrics
chloride.options.displayfps.system.desc: Displays memory usage and GPU usage beside FPS counter
chloride.options.displayfps.margin.title: Text Margin
chloride.options.displayfps.shadow.title: Use Text Shadow Box
chloride.options.displayfps.shadow.desc: Add a Shadow box onto FPS Display, at the pure style of F3
chloride.options.culling.entity.title: Use Max Entity Distance
chloride.options.culling.entity.desc: If enabled, Entities will be hidden based on configured distance limit
chloride.options.culling.entity.distance: Hides and does not tick entities beyond this many blocks. Huge performance increase, especially around modded farms.
Hides and does not tick entities underneath this many blocks, improving performance above caves. This should ideally be set lower than the horizontal distance.
chloride.options.culling.monster.title: Use Max Monster Distance
chloride.options.culling.monster.desc: If enabled, Monsters (hostile entities) will be hidden based on configured distance limit
chloride.options.culling.monster.distanc: Hides and does not tick monsters beyond this many blocks. Huge performance increase, especially around XP farms.
Hides and does not tick monsters underneath this many blocks, improving performance above caves. This should ideally be set lower than the horizontal distance.
chloride.options.culling.tiles.title: Use max Block Entity Distance
chloride.options.culling.tiles.desc: If enabled, Block Entities will be hidden based on configured distance limit
chloride.options.culling.tile.distance.h: Hides block entities beyond this many blocks. Huge performance increase, especially around lots of modded machines.
chloride.options.culling.tile.distance.v: Hides block entities underneath this many blocks, improving performance above caves (if you have your machines in caves, for some reason). This should ideally be set lower than the horizontal distance.
chloride.options.darkness.mode.title: Darkness Mode
chloride.options.darkness.mode.desc:
Makes the rest of the world more realistically dark. Does not effect daytime or torch light.
Controls how dark is considered true darkness.
chloride.options.darkness.others.title: Enable in Other dimensions
chloride.options.darkness.others.desc:
If enabled, true darkness will be applied in other dimensions

[WARNING] This option will be removed in a near future in favor of a blacklist
chloride.options.darkness.overworld.desc: If enabled, true darkness will be applied in the Overworld.
chloride.options.darkness.noskylight.des: If enabled, true darkness will be applied on dimensions without skylight
chloride.options.darkness.nether.title: Enable on Nether
chloride.options.darkness.nether.desc: If enabled, true darkness will be applied in the Nether.
chloride.options.darkness.nether.brightn: Configure fog brightness in the Nether when darkness is enabled.
chloride.options.darkness.end.title: Enable on End
chloride.options.darkness.end.desc: If enabled, true darkness will be applied in the End.
chloride.options.darkness.end.brightness: Configure fog brightness in the End when darkness is enabled.
chloride.options.darkness.blocklightonly: If enabled, Disables sky, fog and moon brightness, making blocks as a only source of light
chloride.options.darkness.moonphase.desc: If enabled, Darkness will be affected by Moon Phases
chloride.options.darkness.moonphase.fres: Configure brightness on a new moon, or minimal bright level on black moon phase
chloride.options.darkness.moonphase.full: Configure brightness on a full moon, or maximum bright level on black moon phase
chloride.options.dynlights.tiles.title: Use for Block Entities
chloride.options.dynlights.tiles.desc:
If enabled, dynamic lighting will be showed on tile entities (furnaces, modded machines, etc).

This can drastically increase the amount of lighting updates, even when you're not around furnaces
chloride.options.dynlights.entities.desc:
If enabled, dynamic lighting will be showed on entities (dropped items, mobs, etc).

This can drastically increase the amount of lighting updates, even when you're not holding a torch.
chloride.options.dynlights.speed.title: Light Updates Speed
chloride.options.dynlights.speed.desc:
Controls how often dynamic lights will update.

Lighting recalculation can be expensive, so slower values will give better performance.
chloride.options.fadein.title: Chunk Fade In Quality
chloride.options.fadein.desc: Controls how fast chunks fade in. No performance hit, Fancy simply takes longer, but looks a bit cooler. Currently not working
chloride.options.leaves_culling.title: Leaves Culling
chloride.options.leaves_culling.desc: Reduces the number of leaves visible faces of the same type, Controls the depth of the culling
chloride.options.fastchest.title: Use Fast Chests
chloride.options.fastchest.desc:
If enabled, replaces chests model with a static model, like a normal block. Breaks chest animation but goes more faster on chest rooms

Option has no effects with flywheel installed and running batching or instancing backend
IMPORTANT: enabling/disabling it requires also enabling/disabling resourcepack
chloride.options.fastbeds.title: Use Fast Beds
chloride.options.fastbeds.desc:
If enabled, replaces dynamic bed model with a static model, like a normal block. Increases performance and also let you use custom models with resource packs
IMPORTANT: enabling/disabling it requires also enabling/disabling resourcepack
chloride.options.fog.title: Use Fog
chloride.options.fog.desc: If disabled, removed fog effect only in the overworld
chloride.options.blueband.title: Use Sky Blue band
chloride.options.blueband.desc: If disabled, removed the Blue Band effect in all dimensions
chloride.options.fontshadow.title: Font Shadows
chloride.options.fontshadow.desc:
If disabled, text will stop rendering shadows giving a flat style.
Increases FPS depending of how much text is on the screen, specially with BetterF3 mods
chloride.options.jei.title: Hide JEI/REI/EMI Until Searching
chloride.options.jei.desc: If enabled, JEI/REI/EMI item list will be hidden unless you search for something. Press space to search for everything.
chloride.options.screen.title: Fullscreen Mode
chloride.options.screen.desc:
Windowed - the game will display in a small window.
Borderless - the game will be fullscreened, and locked to your monitor's refresh rate, but allow you to tab out easily.
Fullscreen - the game will display in native fullscreen mode.
chloride.options.others.borderless.attac:
Configures how Borderless Fullscreen should be attached

ATTACH - Adds it between windowed and Fullscreen
REPLACE - Replaced Fullscreen with Borderless Fullscreen
OFF - Disables Borderless Fullscreen attachment to F11 key
chloride.options.others.languagescreen.f: If enabled, Language updates only reload language instead of all resources, a 99.9% extra of speed
